This is a comprehensive GUI automation suite for Driving Empire that manages multiple self-running job systems through a Linoria-based interface. It features auto-race with checkpoint navigation and track-specific min-time protection, auto-delivery with package pickup/drop-off and seating logic, auto-outlaw for ATM busting and the bank heist with loot prioritization and arrest avoidance, auto-police that targets wanted players using configurable criteria, and an auto-rewards system for claiming quest, playtime, generic, and race leaderboard rewards. The script also includes vehicle spawning/seating, anti-AFK and auto-rejoin safeguards, teleport resume support, a full configuration system with save/load/rename/delete profiles, and a movable toggle button to show/hide the UI.
